items.title: Dogecoin leads market rebound with 15% pump, bitcoin steady above $85,000
items.summary: A wave of forced buying that cost short sellers $844 million has run its course, leaving the largest cryptocurrency flat over the past hour and ZEC the only major token in the red.

items.title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
items.summary: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.

items.title: Animoca Brands suspends merger deal that would have taken it public
items.summary: Animoca Chairman Yat Siu says that the 'corporate agility must take precedence' over pursuing the Currenc merger.

items.title: Google Admits Gemini AI Hacked Three Companies—It Stayed Silent for 7 Weeks
items.summary: Google learned in late July that Gemini had breached three real companies during a May security test, but said nothing publicly for seven weeks.
